t: Dial power and temperature controls for ease of use. Supplied with an adjustable top bracket shower kit with a durable 1.25m anti-twist chrome shower hose. Swivel-fit connection allows for left and right-side water connection and swing-fit connectivity provides left and right-side cable connection with generous footprint for replacement installations. Plus Entry trims can easily be removed and fitted without tools.
b: Suitable for Cold Mains Water Only
